Framework-like editors

Two model-driven editors in the style of Slate/Lexical: a MutationObserver reverts any DOM change the model did not make, and beforeinput (insertReplacementText / deleteContentBackward) is applied through the model and re-rendered asynchronously, like a React commit. The first carries the Slate marker; the second has no framework marker, so the generic ladder tries execCommand first and must recover from the revert.
